frase: Finds jobs in public sources and shows everything in a panel on your computer.
ferramentas.navegador_frase: For LinkedIn and other sites you sign in to. It is downloaded from the internet during installation; you can get it later in Settings › Tools.
falha.arquivo: A file in the installer is not the expected one. Nothing was installed.
falha.arquivo_oque: Download the installer again from the joBot page.
falha.espaco: Not enough disk space. What the installation did was undone.
falha.espaco_oque: Free up some space and try again.
falha.prova: The check of the installed joBot failed. Nothing was installed.
falha.prova_oque: Try again. If it happens again, download the installer again from the joBot page.
falha.navegador: Could not download the browser. What the installation did was undone.
falha.navegador_oque: The browser comes from the internet: check your connection and disk space and try again, or install without it and get it later in Settings › Tools.
falha.outro: The installation did not finish. What it did was undone.
falha.outro_oque: Try again. If it happens again, download the installer again from the joBot page.
incompleto.texto: Files the installation needs are missing. Download the installer again from the joBot page.
alerta.texto: What was done will be undone.
controle.falha.instalar: joBot is not installed for this account. Install joBot again with the installer.
controle.falha.porta: Port {detalhe} is in use by another program. Close that program or set JOBOT_PORTA to another port and try again.
controle.falha.captura: A sample capture with login is running. Stop it in its terminal and try again.
controle.falha.sem_resposta: joBot did not answer on port {detalhe}. Try again.
controle.falha.saiu: joBot closed right after starting. Try again.
controle.falha.subir: Could not start joBot. The system said: {detalhe}. Install joBot again with the installer.
controle.falha.abrir: Could not open the browser. The system said: {detalhe}. Copy the address and open it in your browser.
controle.falha.parar: joBot did not stop in time. It may be finishing a task. Wait a moment and try again.
